visible_description: 一只折纸船在雨后水洼里，找到了树叶做的码头。
synopsis: 雨停后，小禾把纸船放进一条浅窄的水洼，微风却把它送到靠近对岸的地方。爸爸递来一片带长叶柄的宽叶子，小禾握住叶柄，把叶尖伸到纸船旁。船轻轻贴到叶面，她便慢慢把叶子拖回岸边，双手托起。坐回干燥的台阶时，船和叶子一起躺在掌心里，像刚完成了一次很短的航行。
story_text:
雨刚停，小禾就穿着黄雨衣来到院里。爸爸在干燥的台阶旁等她，她则蹲在一条浅窄的水洼边，把早上折好的小纸船放了进去。

船被风推到靠近对岸的地方，离她的指尖还差一点。

她没踩进水里，只蹲着看那条很短的航线。爸爸捡来一片带长叶柄的宽叶子，交到她手里。

小禾握住叶柄，让宽宽的叶面浮在水上，叶尖恰好能碰到船。

船贴上叶面以后，她轻轻把叶柄往回拖，两样东西便一起靠近了干燥的岸边。

她双手托起叶子，带着船回到台阶。爸爸挪出半个位置，小禾坐下时，叶边还滴着水，掌心里的小船却已经准备好下一次出发了。

Her father is an adult with round cheeks, a muted blue rain jacket, and brown boots. Their props are one plain cream paper boat and one broad green fallen leaf. panels.caption: 雨停了，小船刚出门。
panels.scene: Xiaohe crouches safely beside a very shallow narrow courtyard puddle and releases a cream paper boat with two fingertips. Her father stands beside the dry stone step, watching closely. Yellow boots remain on the paving, away from the water. Ripples from the boat spread toward several small reflected patches of pale sky. The panel is a single quiet instant, with clear physical gestures and readable objects. She leans slightly forward from a stable crouch, one arm extended without stepping into the water. Her father watches from her side. A broad fallen leaf lies near his boot on the clean wet paving. panels.caption: 爸爸递来一片宽宽的叶子。

Xiaohe looks from the leaf to the paper boat just beyond fingertip reach in the narrow puddle, beginning to understand the idea. Her yellow boots remain planted securely beside him. panels.caption: 她握住叶柄，让叶尖去接小船。
panels.scene: Xiaohe grips the long stem of the broad green leaf while floating its wide blade across the very narrow shallow puddle. The leaf tip touches the cream paper boat just beyond her fingertips. Her father kneels nearby and watches, while both of her yellow boots remain firmly on the dry paving beside the water. panels.caption: 慢慢拉回叶柄，小船也一起靠岸。
panels.scene: Xiaohe draws the long leaf stem gently toward her body, bringing the broad floating blade and the cream paper boat resting against it back to the near edge of the narrow puddle. Her free hand waits just above the paving to support the leaf once it arrives. Her father stays beside her, watching the simple controlled movement. panels.caption: 连船带码头，一起回家。
panels.scene: Seated on the dry stone step, Xiaohe cradles the leaf in both hands with the little paper boat resting on top. Her father sits beside her, his elbows relaxed on his knees. The shallow puddle glows in the background. A few drops fall from the leaf, leaving tiny dark dots below her boots.
